slides.text:
4 essential hacks
to reach your goal body

slides.bg: two glass jars of overnight oats with berries and a spoon on a kitchen counter in cool calm evening light, close view, no people
slides.text:
1 — Prep breakfast
the night before

Morning-you will eat it

2 — Train at the same time
every day

Decide once, then repeat

3 — Walk while you
take calls

Steps without finding time

slides.heading: 4 — Stop copying plans
slides.body: SOMA builds yours from your watch, your sleep, your life — not someone else's
